QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is commented out at `:2196`. So `threading.c` compiles to nothing useful, and every lock site in the library sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD and says lock sites are gated behind MBEDTLS_THREADING_C.
